info.title: Snapchat Ads - AlSanidi

get.description: Performance metrics for an ad account; use breakdown=campaign for per-campaign rows.

parameters.name: ad_account_id
parameters.description: The Snapchat ad account ID.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: TOTAL and LIFETIME return one total; DAY and HOUR return a time series (start/end time required).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: ISO 8601 start, aligned to the hour in the ad account time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+03:00.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: ISO 8601 end (exclusive), aligned to the hour.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names. Spend values are in micro-currency (divide by 1,000,000).

parameters.name: breakdown
parameters.description: Return stats per child entity as well.

parameters.name: report_dimension
parameters.description: Split stats by audience attribute, e.g. age, gender, age,gender, country, os.

parameters.name: swipe_up_attribution_window
parameters.description: Click-through attribution window.

parameters.name: view_attribution_window
parameters.description: View-through attribution window.

parameters.name: action_report_time
parameters.description: Attribute conversions to conversion or impression time.

parameters.name: conversion_source_types
parameters.description: Comma-separated: web, app, offline, total, total_off_platform, total_on_platform.

parameters.name: omit_empty
parameters.description: Drop rows with no activity.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Set to true for large pulls; returns a report_run_id to poll with 'Get async stats report'.

parameters.name: async_format
parameters.description: File format of an async report.
